trial_court: Court of Ramesh Kumar-II, District Judge (Commercial Court)-08, Central, Tis Hazari Courts, Extension Block: Delhi.
case_name: M/S Khattar Enterprises vs M/S Shree Mahabir Infrastrcture

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: M/s. Khattar Enterprises, Through its Proprietor Sh. Satish Khattar
parties.respondent_defendant: M/s. Shree Mahavir Infrastructure, Through its Proprietor Sh. Jitendra Kumar

facts_of_case: The plaintiff is engaged in the business of construction machines on hire basis under the name and style of M/s Khattar Enterprises. The defendant approached the plaintiff at Delhi office and expressed his desire to avail the services of the plaintiff. The defendant had availed the services on credit basis from the plaintiff, but did not make payment.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the plaintiff to prove that the defendant received the proforma invoices.
legal_principles.held: PW1 also deposed that he has not annexed the front page of the log book upon which the word 'name of defendant and defendant's firm' is mentioned but voluntarily stated that in the internal pages of the log book.

legal_principles.principle: The plaintiff must show the entries pertaining to serial no.1 mentioned in the column 'particular' from the log book.
legal_principles.held: Q. Can you show the entries pertaining to serial no.1 mentioned in the column 'particular' from the log book?

outcome.final_order: The court ordered recovery of Rs.29,60,169/- alongwith pendente lite and future interest.

use_for_drafting: preparing a civil suit for debt recovery
understanding the Indian Evidence Act in a commercial dispute
